sources.observation: The stone front has an arched portal, rose window and twin curved stone tower caps. The church roof stands above the cloister and plaza slopes.
The long stucco ranges border the west plaza. The nave and raised transepts extend between groups of open cloister courts.

limitations: Bell profiles, sculpture, buttress caps, garden detail and individual windows are photo-based interpretations. The church and monastery interiors are outside scope.
